name: Spindle overheating
symptoms: spindle housing too hot to touch
thermal alarm after about two hours running
lay_description: spindle is running hot and the machine keeps throwing a temperature alarm
root_cause: clogged filter in the spindle chiller circuit
valid_fixes: lock out the machine
drain the chiller reservoir
remove and clean the chiller filter
refill with the correct coolant
run for 30 minutes and confirm the temperature stays under limit

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: bearings were fine, the heat came from restricted coolant flow
only hid the symptom, alarm came back at normal speed

name: Chatter and poor surface finish
symptoms: wavy surface finish on the part
tool marks repeating at regular spacing
lay_description: parts are coming off rough with a wavy finish and the cut sounds awful
root_cause: turret not fully clamped because chips are packed under the clamp face
valid_fixes: stop the spindle and lock out
index the turret to a free station
clean chips and old coolant from the turret clamp face
check the turret seats flat with a feeler gauge
re-run a test cut

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: chatter stayed because the turret was still moving under load
insert was not the issue

name: Chuck not clamping
lay_description: chuck lets go of the part and the pressure alarm keeps coming up
root_cause: worn seal in the rotary hydraulic union leaking pressure
valid_fixes: stop the spindle and lock out
depressurise the chuck hydraulic line and verify zero
remove the rotary union cover
replace the worn union seal kit
re-pressurise and test clamping with a scrap part

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: leak got worse and pressure still dropped, and it risks overclamping
jaws were not worn

name: X-axis servo overload
symptoms: X axis overload alarm on rapid moves
axis feels stiff when moved by hand
lay_description: the X axis is stalling and throwing an overload alarm
root_cause: starved ball screw because the way-lube line is clogged
valid_fixes: lock out and wait for drive discharge
trace the way-lube line to the X ball screw
clear the blocked lube line and replace the clogged metering block
run the lube pump manually until oil appears
jog the axis and confirm the load drops

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor was healthy, the screw was dry and dragging
masked the problem and risks damaging the screw

name: Coolant pump no flow
lay_description: no coolant is coming out even though the pump is running
root_cause: suction strainer packed with swarf
valid_fixes: lock out the machine
remove the tank cover
lift out and clean the suction strainer
refill coolant to the mark and bleed the pump
restart and check flow at the nozzle

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: the pump was fine, the strainer was blocked

wrong_fixes.action: added more coolant to the tank
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: level was not the problem

name: Turret fails to index
symptoms: turret sometimes locks but control says unclamped
lay_description: the turret will not finish its index and times out
root_cause: clamp proximity sensor out of position
valid_fixes: lock out the machine
locate the turret clamp proximity sensor
reset the sensor gap to the manual value
tighten the bracket and recheck the signal on the diagnostics screen
cycle the turret ten times

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor was never failing
parameters were correct

name: Parts drifting out of tolerance
symptoms: first parts good then they drift
offsets look right on the screen
lay_description: parts start good then slowly go out of size
root_cause: damaged tool setter probe giving bad offset readings
valid_fixes: stop the machine safely
test the tool setter probe against a known gauge pin
replace the damaged probe tip
recalibrate tool offsets
run a five-part check

wrong_fixes.action: kept adjusting the offsets by hand
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: the probe kept feeding wrong values so the drift came back
inserts were not the cause

name: Spindle encoder fault
symptoms: encoder alarm that comes and goes
alarm worse when the door opens
lay_description: spindle speed readout jumps around and the encoder alarm comes and goes
root_cause: encoder cable chafed in the drag chain
valid_fixes: lock out and wait for drive discharge
inspect the encoder cable along the drag chain
replace the chafed cable section
re-route and clip the cable clear of the chain edge
power up and confirm a stable speed reading

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: drive was fine, the signal was being lost in the cable

wrong_fixes.action: cleared the alarm and carried on
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: alarm kept returning

name: Slow ram descent
lay_description: the ram is crawling down and the pump sounds strained
root_cause: clogged pump suction strainer
valid_fixes: lock out and depressurise the press
drain the tank to the strainer level
remove and clean the suction strainer
refill with filtered oil
run empty cycles and time the ram

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: did not fix flow starvation and over-pressurised the system
pump was cavitating from the blocked strainer

name: Pressure will not build
lay_description: press will not come up to pressure even though the pump is running
root_cause: relief valve stuck partly open from contamination
valid_fixes: lock out and depressurise the press
remove the relief valve cartridge
flush and clean the valve seat
inspect the poppet for scoring and replace if marked
reinstall and set the relief pressure to rated value with a gauge

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: pump was delivering fine, oil was bleeding back through the relief valve
level was already correct

name: Ram drifts down under hold
lay_description: the ram creeps down by itself when it should be holding
root_cause: worn piston seal letting oil pass inside the cylinder
valid_fixes: support the ram with safety blocks
lock out and depressurise the press
remove the cylinder head
replace the piston seals and check the bore
reassemble and run a hold test for ten minutes

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: there was no external leak, the oil was passing inside
valve was fine

name: Hydraulic oil overheating
lay_description: hydraulic oil is running hot and the temperature alarm trips
root_cause: oil cooler fan failed and cooler fins fouled
valid_fixes: lock out the machine and let the oil cool
check the cooler fan rotation and motor
replace the failed fan motor
clean the cooler fins with low-pressure air
run and confirm oil temperature stabilises

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: oil level was fine, cooling was the issue
helped nothing while the cooler was blocked

name: Jerky ram movement
lay_description: the ram moves in jerks and the oil looks foamy
root_cause: air drawn into the circuit through a loose suction fitting
valid_fixes: lock out and depressurise
inspect all suction side fittings and hoses
tighten or replace the leaking suction fitting
bleed air from the circuit at the cylinder bleed points
run cycles until motion is smooth

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: valve was fine, air in the oil caused the jerking
foam came back as the leak remained

name: Light curtain fault stops cycle
symptoms: press will not start a cycle
lay_description: the press refuses to cycle and the light curtain keeps faulting
root_cause: light curtain misaligned and lens dirty
valid_fixes: lock out the machine
clean the emitter and receiver lenses
realign the light curtain using the alignment indicators
run the safety function test and record it
get supervisor sign-off before returning to production

wrong_fixes.action: bypassed the light curtain to keep producing
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: unsafe and illegal: removes operator protection
relay was healthy

name: Oil leak at cylinder gland
symptoms: oil film on the cylinder rod
lay_description: oil is weeping out around the cylinder rod
root_cause: worn rod seal damaged by a scored rod
valid_fixes: support the ram with safety blocks
lock out and depressurise
remove the gland and old rod seal
polish minor rod scoring or replace the rod if deep
fit a new rod seal and wiper and test for leaks

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: squeezed the seal harder and wore the rod faster
tape does not hold hydraulic pressure

name: Pump motor trips on start
symptoms: overload trips as the pump starts
lay_description: the pump motor trips out every time it starts
root_cause: pitted contactor contacts causing a phase imbalance
valid_fixes: lock out and prove dead
open the starter cabinet and inspect the contactor
replace the pitted contactor
check the motor current on all three phases
start and confirm the overload stays closed

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor ran with an imbalance and risked burning out
motor was healthy

name: Short shots
symptoms: shot size varies shot to shot
lay_description: parts are coming out incomplete and the shot size is all over the place
root_cause: worn check ring letting melt flow back
valid_fixes: lock out and let the barrel cool to a safe temperature
pull the screw
inspect the check ring and seat
replace the worn check ring set
reinstall and confirm a steady cushion

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: melt just flowed back more and risked flash
cushion still varied

name: Flash on parts
symptoms: thin flash on the parting line
flash gets worse over the shift
lay_description: thin flash keeps showing up around the edge of the parts
root_cause: debris on the mould parting line
valid_fixes: lock out and make sure the mould is cool
open the mould and clean the parting faces
inspect for damaged shut-off surfaces
apply mould protector and close slowly
run a test shot

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: damages the mould and platens without fixing the debris
flash stayed

name: Barrel temperature runaway
symptoms: one zone reads low but material is smoking
lay_description: one barrel zone keeps heating and the material is smoking
root_cause: failed thermocouple reading low so the heater stays on
valid_fixes: switch off the heaters and lock out
let the barrel cool
test the zone thermocouple against a reference
replace the failed thermocouple
power up and watch the zone reach setpoint without overshoot

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: band was working, the sensor misled the controller
made the overheating worse

name: Screw will not rotate
symptoms: screw stuck after a cold start
lay_description: the screw will not turn after starting from cold
root_cause: unmelted plastic frozen in the barrel after a cold start
valid_fixes: lock out the screw drive
bring the barrel up to temperature and heat soak for the full soak time
retry screw rotation at low torque
purge the barrel with a purging compound
verify the melt temperature is stable

wrong_fixes.action: forced the screw with higher torque
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: can shear the screw
motor was fine

name: Ejector sticking
lay_description: the ejector is sticking and parts hang up in the mould
root_cause: dry ejector guide pins with no lubrication
valid_fixes: lock out the machine
open the mould and pull the ejector plate
clean and inspect the guide pins and bushes
apply the correct mould grease
cycle the ejector by hand to check smooth travel

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: bent pins and left the real cause

wrong_fixes.action: sprayed release agent on the parts
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: covered the problem for a few shots

name: Black specks in parts
symptoms: black specks in the moulded parts
parts look streaky after a restart
lay_description: there are little black specks in the parts
root_cause: carbonised material trapped in a dead spot in the barrel and hot runner
valid_fixes: lock out and make sure the area is safe from molten material
purge the barrel with purging compound
clean the nozzle and hot runner tip
dry the material and check the dryer settings
run parts and inspect for specks

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: masterbatch was not the source

wrong_fixes.action: lowered the barrel temperature below spec
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: caused cold slugs without clearing the carbon

name: Mould will not close fully
symptoms: a part is visible in the cavity
lay_description: the mould stops before closing and trips an alarm
root_cause: a part stuck in the cavity from the previous cycle
valid_fixes: stop the machine and lock out
never reach in while the platens can move
remove the stuck part with brass tools
check for damage to the mould faces
reset and cycle slowly with mould protection on

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: crushes the mould with the part still in place

wrong_fixes.action: reset the alarm and tried again
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: same stuck part blocked the close

name: Water leak at cooling manifold
lay_description: water is leaking near the mould and the floor is wet under the manifold
root_cause: cracked hose coupling on the cooling water manifold
valid_fixes: isolate the water supply and lock out the machine
dry the area before touching electrical parts
cut out and replace the cracked coupling
check the manifold for other cracks
restore water and check for leaks

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: tape does not hold under pressure

wrong_fixes.action: ignored it and mopped the floor
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: leak grew and reached the cabinet

name: Belt mistracking
lay_description: the belt keeps wandering off to one side
root_cause: build-up on an idler roller pushing the belt off line
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
find the idler with build-up
clean the roller surface and check it spins freely
square the roller to the frame
restart and watch the belt track for a few minutes

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: over-tensioned the belt and damaged the bearings
wasted material and tracking stayed wrong

name: Belt slipping at the drive
symptoms: belt slips on the drive pulley
motor runs but belt speed is low
lay_description: the drive spins but the belt does not move properly
root_cause: worn lagging on the drive pulley
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
inspect the drive pulley lagging
re-lag or replace the pulley lagging
check belt tension against the spec
test run loaded

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: stressed bearings and the slip returned
belt was fine

name: Gearbox overheating and noise
lay_description: the gearbox is very hot and grinding
root_cause: low gearbox oil level
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
let the gearbox cool before opening
check the oil level and condition
top up with the specified gear oil and look for leaks
run and confirm casing temperature

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor was healthy
wrong lubricant for the gearbox

name: Drive overcurrent trips
symptoms: fault when the belt is loaded
lay_description: the drive trips on overcurrent every time the belt loads up
root_cause: seized idler roller dragging on the belt
valid_fixes: stop, lock out and wait for drive discharge
spin the idler rollers by hand to find the seized one
replace the seized roller and bearing
check belt and drive current
restart and confirm no overcurrent trip

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor ran hotter and the drag remained
drive was not at fault

name: Photo-eye false stops
symptoms: conveyor stops with nothing in the way
fault more common in the afternoon
lay_description: the line keeps stopping for no reason and the sensor flickers
root_cause: dirty and slightly misaligned photo-eye
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
clean the sensor lens and reflector
realign the sensor and reflector
check the signal on the diagnostics screen
restart and watch several cycles

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: unsafe: product can pile up and block detection
card was fine

name: Chain skipping
symptoms: slack hanging on the return side
lay_description: the chain keeps jumping on the sprocket and clicking
root_cause: stretched drive chain
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
measure the chain elongation
replace the stretched chain
check sprocket tooth wear
re-tension to spec and lubricate

wrong_fixes.action: tightened the chain tensioner to the limit
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: chain still jumped and wore the sprocket
stretch was the cause

name: E-stop pull cord trips randomly
symptoms: line stops at random with an e-stop fault
pull cord switch resets by itself
lay_description: the line randomly drops out on an e-stop fault
root_cause: water ingress and corroded terminals in the pull cord switch
valid_fixes: lock out and prove dead
open the pull cord switch box and dry it out
replace corroded terminals and the switch seal
test the e-stop circuit end to end
get supervisor sign-off before returning to production

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: removes a life-safety function
relay was fine

name: Roller bearing squeal
symptoms: high pitched squeal from one roller
lay_description: one roller is squealing and runs rough
root_cause: failed roller bearing with no grease
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the conveyor
identify the squealing roller by spinning by hand
replace the failed bearing
grease all bearings to schedule
restart and listen

wrong_fixes.action: sprayed lubricant onto the running roller
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: unsafe near a moving belt and does not repair the bearing
noise stayed

name: Fails to reach pressure
lay_description: the compressor runs and runs but never reaches full pressure
root_cause: blocked air intake filter
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
vent the receiver to zero
remove and inspect the intake filter
replace the filter element
restart and check the build-up time

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: overpressure risk without fixing the intake
element was fine

name: Excess oil carryover
lay_description: there is oil coming through in the air lines
root_cause: failed oil separator element
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
vent to zero pressure
let the oil cool
remove the separator cover and old element
fit a new separator element and top up oil

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: cooler was not the source

wrong_fixes.action: drained the air receiver more often
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: oil came from the separator

name: High discharge temperature
symptoms: fan running but air feels weak
lay_description: the compressor overheats and trips on high discharge temperature
root_cause: fouled cooler fins restricting airflow
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
let it cool
clean the cooler fins with low-pressure air from the clean side
check the cooling fan direction
restart and watch temperature

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: level was correct and overfilling causes carryover
sensor reading was accurate

name: Short cycling
symptoms: compressor starts and stops every few seconds
lay_description: the compressor keeps starting and stopping every few seconds
root_cause: leaking minimum pressure check valve
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
vent to zero pressure
remove the check valve and inspect the seat
replace the valve or seal
restart and watch the cycle

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: switch was fine
did not stop the leak

name: Water in the air lines
lay_description: there is water coming out of the air tools
root_cause: blocked automatic drain valve on the receiver
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
vent the receiver to zero
clean or replace the auto drain valve
manually drain and check for rust
restart and verify the drain cycles

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: dryer was working, the drain was blocked
did not remove the water

name: Motor trips on overload
lay_description: the motor trips out on overload and hums when it starts
root_cause: loose power terminal causing single phasing
valid_fixes: lock out and prove dead
inspect the motor and starter terminals
tighten or replace the burned terminal
check current balance on all phases
restart and monitor

wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: motor was fine
damages the motor over time

name: Safety valve popping
lay_description: the safety valve keeps blowing off
root_cause: faulty pressure switch so the compressor never unloads
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
vent to zero pressure
test the pressure switch against a calibrated gauge
replace the faulty pressure switch
restart and confirm it unloads at cut-out

wrong_fixes.action: plugged the safety valve to stop the noise
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: extremely dangerous: removes overpressure protection

wrong_fixes.action: fitted a higher rated safety valve
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: hides a control failure and is unsafe

name: Belt squeal and vibration
symptoms: visible vibration at the belt guard
lay_description: the belt squeals and the whole guard shakes
root_cause: worn and loose drive belt
valid_fixes: stop and lock out the compressor
remove the belt guard
check belt wear and tension
replace the belt and re-tension
refit the guard and test

wrong_fixes.action: sprayed belt dressing on the running belt
wrong_fixes.why_it_fails: unsafe near rotating parts and only a temporary fix
bearings were fine
